'''G'wenee''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Planet/Legends|tradeworld]] whose operations were overseen by [[Tarrant Snil]], who proved to be an adversary to [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Snil was captured by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kir Kanos|Kenix Kil]].
